title: Fixed-choice machine
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols and let $b$ be a Boolean choice. Define the machine obtained from $N$ by always using choice $b$ at every transition; it has the same number of work tapes, states, and initial state as $N$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
